title: Ruthless Bar Salts StrawMelon On Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Ruthless Bar Salts StrawMelon on Ice brings together two of the most refreshing fruit flavours for a vibrant and uplifting vape. Juicy Strawberries provide a burst of summer flavour, while Watermelon adds a fresh, delicately sweet quality. A brisk layer of cooling menthol rounds out the mix, providing a clean, crisp finish that makes Strawmelon on Ice a truly exceptional all-day vape. With a 50VG/50PG blend, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices, offering a satisfying balance of bold flavour and smooth vapour production. The nicotine salt formulation delivers a silky throat hit and fast nicotine absorption for a consistently satisfying vape. Ruthless has built a reputation as one of the pioneers of the US vaping scene, crafting expertly blended shortfills and nic salts that push the boundaries of flavour. Their commitment to premium ingredients and innovative profiles ensures each e-liquid delivers a standout vaping experience.
